description: How a cache or artifact of the workspace root treats the volumes mounted below it. Both agents are checked against this one file: internal/agent (host, isolated and native) and internal/k8sagent. Edit it only when the rule deliberately changes, and both sides must keep passing. The workspace is /workspace.

relative.description: two volumes at relative mount paths

artifact: artifact path "." excludes volume "go-cache" mounted at ".ucd-cache/go": the contents of a volume are never archived as part of a parent directory; name the volume's mount path to archive it
artifact path "." excludes volume "tools" mounted at "tools": the contents of a volume are never archived as part of a parent directory; name the volume's mount path to archive it
cacheSave: cache save path "." excludes volume "go-cache" mounted at ".ucd-cache/go": the contents of a volume are never archived as part of a parent directory; name the volume's mount path to archive it
cache save path "." excludes volume "tools" mounted at "tools": the contents of a volume are never archived as part of a parent directory; name the volume's mount path to archive it
cacheRestore: cache restore path "." excludes volume "go-cache" mounted at ".ucd-cache/go": the contents of a volume are never archived as part of a parent directory; name the volume's mount path to archive it
cache restore path "." excludes volume "tools" mounted at "tools": the contents of a volume are never archived as part of a parent directory; name the volume's mount path to archive it

absolute.description: one relative mount and one absolute mount path that lands inside the workspace: the spelling of the mount path makes no difference. Isolated and Kubernetes only: a native claim cannot mount inside its workspace by an absolute path.
